coreIdea: (Set, Operation). Checklist: Closure → Associative → Identity → Inverse (= Group) → Commutative (= Abelian). Lagrange: |H| divides |G|.
mustRememberFormulas: Largest proper subgroup order = largest divisor of |G| strictly < |G|
Generators of cyclic group of order n = φ(n)

0 (mult.) / singular matrices always fail inverse check
